data.name: Bo Le Judging Horses
data.detailed_description:
Today is the Chinese Spring Festival, the Year of the Horse. Wishing you the spirit of the Dragon-Horse, energetic and thriving all year long!

Bole originally referred to a person in ancient Chinese history who was skilled at judging fine horses. Today, the term is metaphorically used to describe someone who excels at discovering and cultivating talents. You shall embody the role of Bole, visit the renowned scenic spots and historical sites across China, and select the cherished thousand-li horse in your heart. There is no cause for concern if you have not yet found the right one for the time being. A classical allusion from Chinese history has since evolved into a venerable idiom: When the frontier elder lost his horse, who could say it was not a blessing? Laozi's Tao Te Ching further states: "Misfortune is that upon which good fortune leans; good fortune is that in which misfortune lurks."

The game encompasses nearly all of China's iconic scenic spots and historical sites, and we will listen closely to players' wishes and enrich the collection. Boasting simple and beginner-friendly gameplay, the game features over a hundred extraordinary and distinguished horses. All you need to do is wield the Ruyi with a tender brush to grace the ideal thousand-li horse in your heart. Countless festive Chinese New Year idioms and timeless ancient Chinese poetry are waiting for you to unlock in the game. We have composed a series of original soundtracks infused with traditional Chinese music, performed using traditional Chinese and Western musical instruments.

Come and fully immerse yourself in savoring China's magnificent rivers and mountains and history and culture as you seek out the legendary thousand-li horses!

data.short_description: Only when Bole graces the world can a thousand-li horse emerge. Thousand-li horses are plentiful, yet Bole remains rare. At this very moment! On the first day of the first lunar month in the Bingwu Year of the Horse. A grand presentation!
